text.tspan: Proposed function-level design derived from the SRS. Class, method, DTO and parameter names may change during implementation. Business behavior, data and branch conditions follow the cited UC / BR / NS requirements. UI messages are translated; SRS message IDs are retained.
Preconditions: valid session, required role, active Student account; JWT authentication under Section 5.2.1. E1 applies to both initial loading and retrieval of additional entries.

[transaction not found or not owned by the Student — E2]
[the source activity is no longer accessible — A3]

credit / debit direction and coin amount
